    • configure

      public void configure(ContentProcessorOptions props)
      Description copied from interface: ContentProcessor
      Configure this instance of ContentProcessor with some options. There can be different instances of the same processor, processing different content types. This methods allow to specifically configure different processors with different parameters.
      Specified by:
      configure in interface ContentProcessor
      Parameters:
      props - Options to apply to this processor.

      public Content getStructure(Content origin, String attribute, int startLevel, ContentProcessingOptions options) throws ContentProcessorException
      Description copied from interface: ContentProcessor
      Get a outputContentType dependent representation of the Content structure TODO: See a way of returning the actual structure, instead of a "cooked" one.
      Specified by:
      getStructure in interface ContentProcessor
      Parameters:
      origin - The original content for which we want to get the structure.
      attribute - From which attribute we get the body?
      startLevel - Ignore any levels (header levels, h1, h2, h3, etc) lower than this.
      options - Options applying to the way we are getting the information
      Returns:
      Content that will represent the structure of some other content
      Throws:
      ContentProcessorException - If the content format is invalid
